metadata.name: Cell — QUAD ADAPTABILITY (4-zone spiral, wall-drop reveal; same EFE-arbiter brain)
metadata.description: QUAD adaptability maze — 4 zones, progressive wall-drop reveal. Same brain as the_cell_arbiter (efe arbiter + klino + planner w/ confinement steer). Run the_cell_arbiter (single zone) first, then switch here to show scale/complexity adaptability.
metadata._comment_forage: falloff 12->15 for env parity with the_cell_arbiter_quad_play (the play A/B partner): the far-field foraging reach fix (see quad_play _comment_forage). Keep identical across the quad set so play-vs-no-play is the only difference.
metadata._comment_scent: publish_scent_ring=false → the body virtualizes scent POSITION-ONLY (a scalar sampled at the bug's centre, frame-independent 'bath'). The directional 8-nostril ring (reality.proprio.scent) is a scaffold / different sensory modality and is fully bypassed here — nothing in this config consumes it (klino=RunTumbleNav is scalar run-and-tumble, direction emerges from motion). Defensible chemotaxis: no directional read of the source.
metadata._comment_quad: QUAD adaptability env: 2x2 spiral of 4 zones (SW->SE->NE->NW) of increasing complexity, isolated by a + cross with 3 DROPPABLE connectors. Bug boxed in Z1; connectors open on wall_drop_period ticks (headless) or KEY_D (UI). One fixed food per zone. Demonstrates the planner+confinement-steer discovering new zones as they open.

params._comment: LEARNED advance (genuine 'act on a heading') + wedge-escape safety net + explore-on-lost. Defensible action layer.
params._comment_hk: advance_homeokinetic: reward = max(0,vel_fwd) − effort·|vel_fwd| (food-DECOUPLED, intrinsic controllable motion). No cos(bearing) → off-axis forward not punished → off-axis forward is no longer punished into NEGATIVE; the table STILL flattens to ~0 when STUCK (reward 0 → EMA → 0) — the hunger-gated escape recovers it. nav+turn-priority handle aiming.

params._comment: QUICK KICK away from walls: HOLD steer-away for pulse_ticks (effective impulse), then refractory release so the cog resurfaces, drives, and LEARNS the turn. pulse_ticks + refractory_ticks are live HotMutable sliders — tune the kick feel to taste.
MISMATCH stuck: commands motion but doesn't achieve it (|afferent|<<|intended|). Self-normalizing, no velocity threshold. Turning/idle (intended~0) never fires. refractory 120.

L2 active-inference policy selection. scoring_mode='efe' (ACTIVE): each policy scored as an EXPECTED FREE ENERGY G = pragmatic (hunger×reach-prob) + epistemic ((1−hunger)×uncertainty-reduction). The two PRAGMATIC terms share units (hunger×reach-prob) so the klino/planner scale mismatch is gone BY CONSTRUCTION — no cede, no plan_peak self-norm, no max-of-three. klino reach-prob = its eat-calibrated capability (cap→1 in its own eating range); planner reach-prob = its DISCOUNTED route value (γ^hops<1 to a remembered cache) → near food g_prag_klino=hunger>hunger·γ^hops so klino OWNS THE CLOSE decisively. klino epistemic = the z-spike (scent rising = 'food this way', wins the approach); hunger sets the exploit↔explore balance (no tuned λ). vs value_race (the legacy asymmetric z-score/level race). winner-take-all with margin=hysteresis_k·running_std(G_klino−G_planner). Hard gains 1/0 → MotorBus arbiter.gain.<name>. Watch the four-term race + precision meters in the xaq_inspector EFEArbiter widget. force_policy ablations: ''=live / 'klino' / 'planner' / 'shuffle'. seed42 300s: efe 4 eats / hunger 0.19 vs value_race 2 eats / hunger 0.26 (efe hands the fast direct forager more authority when sated → breaks the planner-crawl starvation).

proportional_mix = TURN-PRIORITY: cog passes linear below unity (gain 0.75 keeps it off the limiter → headroom for the steer differential + the whisker pulse, channels linked). The turn gets range first (can drive the opposite paddle negative = pivot → tight radius ~6.5 vs 8.8); forward yields. Fixes the wide-arc. cog gain is a live slider: ↑ = faster forward/wider, ↓ = tighter.
params._comment_tb: turn_brake=3: forward yields hard to the turn so the bug pivots-in to the food (converge) instead of orbiting it — needed because the homeokinetic advance drives forward-always. Live slider.
params._comment_arbiter: gain_mod_prefix wires planner→arbiter.gain.planner, klino→arbiter.gain.klino (whisker/stuck have no arbiter gain → default 1.0, safety layer never muted). effective_gain = base · arbiter → mix AND authority, so the muted loop gets 0 authority and its advance learning pauses. Base gains 0.75 → a 1.0 arbiter gain passes the loop under the limiter; a 0.0 mutes it cleanly.
